newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KGHM unions decide on labour dispute - PAP.
newsitem.headline: Polish KGHM unions decide on labour dispute - PAP.

text.p: Seven trade unions at Poland's copper concern KGHM Polska Miedz SA have decided to start a collective labour dispute, PAP news agency said on Friday.
Neither KGHM nor the concern's union officials were immediately available to comment on the PAP report.
PAP said the unions were demanding higher wages along with social and employment guarantees after KGHM's planned share floation later this year.

"We want...a packet of social guarantees, which will include guaranteeing employment for at least 10 years, increasing the payment fund at a level not lower than the rate of inflation and keeping sector rights for miners, mill workers as well as pensioners," PAP quoted Jozef Czyczerski, the head of the copper ore mining branch of the Solidarity trade union.
It said that the first negotiations between the unions and KGHM management will take place on March 20.
Under Polish law a collective dispute is one of the stages to be gone through before a strike can legally be called but it need not necessarily result in a work stoppage.
